t: Teen Mom 2: He Didn't Look Like a Prince
st: He Didn't Look Like a Prince
d: Leah breaks up with Jason. Jenelle's plans to take Jace on a trip go awry. Briana leaves Luis alone with Stella for the first time. Kailyn gets child support advice from TMOG's Amber. (S9, ep16)

t: Teen Mom 2: Checks and Balances
d: Chelsea suffers a panic attack. Jenelle visits Briana in Orlando but struggles to film without her husband. Addie is confused about Leah and Jeremy's relationship. (S9, ep17)

t: Teen Mom 2: Family Portrait
d: Leah and Jeremy rush Addie to the ER. Jenelle questions her future with Teen Mom 2. Briana lets DeVoin take a major step forward with Nova. Chelsea debates how to treat her anxiety. (S9, ep18)

t: Teen Mom 2: Hey Girl Hey
d: Jade joins the cast of Teen Mom 2 but trust issues threaten an important anniversary with Sean. When Briana allows Devoin to take Nova for the weekend, he disappoints her in a big way. (S9, ep19)

t: Teen Mom 2: Welcome to the Jungle
d: Briana confronts Devoin in New York. Jade tries to smooth things over with Sean before moving into their new house. Leah and Kailyn vacation together in Costa Rica. (S9, ep20)

t: Teen Mom 2: Direct Message
d: Leah faces another health scare with Addie. Jade and Sean reach boiling point, forcing her to move out. Briana is torn when she gets a suspicious DM about John. Adam surprises Aubree. (S9, ep21)

t: Teen Mom 2: Truth Hurts
d: Leah's sister Victoria makes a shocking revelation, Jade finds out that Sean has been deceiving her, and Briana and John discuss their future while in the Dominican Republic. (S9, ep22)

t: Teen Mom 2: Walking the Walk
d: When Nova misses her dad, Briana puts her anger with DeVoin aside. Jade tries to distance herself from Sean. Leah's kids become suspicious of her possible romance with Jeremy. (S9, ep23)

t: Teen Mom 2: Make It or Break It
d: Sean pleads with Jade to let him see Kloie. Jo throws a wrench into Kailyn's vacation plans while Leah considers what this Hawaii trip could mean for her and Jeremy. (S9, ep24)

t: Teen Mom 2: Getting Lei'd
d: Briana celebrates Stella's birthday, Jade grows frustrated with her mother, Leah's daughters have mixed feelings about Jeremy, and Chelsea gets a creative opportunity. (S9, ep25)

t: Teen Mom 2: Normal Parents
d: Jade's relationship with her mum deteriorates. Things for Briana and John crumble when she visits him. Ali gains independence at a camp for children with muscular dystrophy. (S9, ep26)

t: Teen Mom 2: Bailout
d: When Jade's parents are arrested, she's forced to pick up the pieces. Devoin tries to prove to Briana that he can be around for Nova. Leah welcomes Ali home from camp. (S9, ep27)

t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Drifting Apart
d: Chloe is struggling to fully trust Jack. Isha feels like her and Jamie are drifting apart. Whitney goes on her first date in 2 years! Angel and Matt try to work through their issues.

t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Working Out
d: Isha turns to the gym to improve her mental health. Whitney's reaches breaking point. Jack has got a big surprise planned for Chloe. It's showtime for Angel, who goes into labour.

t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: New Highs
d: Matt and Angel welcome a new member to the family! Jack makes a big promise to Chloe and E-H. Whitney and Elizabeth seal their bond. Isha and Jamie's relationship hits new highs and lows.

t: Teen Mom UK: A New Chapter For Some
d: Teen Moms are back! Sassi's dreams of her future without Darren, and Mia's dreaming of an easier life with Marliya and Maggie. Amber's got her life on track, but Ste could derail things.

t: Teen Mom UK: Old Problems And New
d: Amber's problems with Ste are getting worse and Mia's worried about Marliya after she falls ill. Chloe's making sure Marley's ready to become a brother, and Sassi is chasing her dreams.

t: Teen Mom UK: Looking Forward or Back?
d: Chloe's in a celebratory mood as she finally has the baby shower. Sassi rolls up her sleeves, Amber's dealing with an old foe, and Mia tries to bury the hatchet with Maggie.

t: Teen Mom UK: The Big Days
d: Amber and Ste have a final showdown. Meanwhile, Mia has a final showdown of her own with Maggie. Sassi's launching her brand new business. The big day has finally come for Chloe!

t: Teen Mom 2: Don't Miss the Sunset
d: Luis reappears with a major ask for Briana. Sean's rent is late, forcing Jade to make a difficult choice. Kailyn gets upsetting news. Chelsea celebrates Aubree's 10th birthday. (S9, ep29)
